title: Adversarial review question
summary: JSON Schema for one question of the owner's 1,024-question review bank: AVQ id, area, exact question, failure hypothesis, check or fix, severity, modes, stages, style filters, named passes.
description: This is the owner's authoritative adversarial review bank: the 1,024 questions of Appendix E of the Animation and Video Production Master Guide (10 Oct 2026), transcribed with the owner's exact text, ids, filters and pass membership. Another builder in this catalogue (harness_kit) independently wrote a different 1,024-question bank; it is not this set and does not override it.

review.notes: Generator asserts 1,024 questions with unique ids, 32 per area, nine passes matching declared counts, and every record valid against the adversarial_question schema.

evidence_notes: All 1,024 transcribed questions validate against this schema (jsonschema, Draft 2020-12) in the generator run, and the examples validate in the catalogue validator. Field names follow the appendix's own labels.
